en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a small pine‑covered islet connected to the mainland by a narrow causeway in a calm bay. Whitewashed houses with tiled roofs are seen in the foreground, looking down toward the harbor. There are a few small boats in the water and low hills or islands in the distance. The card has a decorative border and printed captions in Greek and French at the bottom, along with a website watermark.
